supersedes: tp-grouped-queryswap-001 (status there remains DESIGNED_NOT_RUN; its execution is recorded in output/lineage_sft5_queryswap.json as DEVELOPMENT_ONLY with recorded defects)
role: CLEAN_REPLICATION: same parent, fixed split, group-unit objective, preregistered trajectory, frozen independent replication fixture. NOT a new capability suite; OOD-5 remains forbidden until this resolves.
hypothesis: Query-swap counterfactual training increases query-conditioned preference for the correct context value on disjoint vocabulary and independent fact groups, while preserving context extraction and protected capabilities.

parent.note: SAME parent as SFT5 (P12). Never continue from sft5-queryswap.

design.unit: queryswap GROUP = one fact block of k facts (k in {2,3,4} deliberate), one query variant per fact; all members share the identical fact block and differ only in query and correct value
design.optimization: TRUE GROUP LOSS: one micro-unit consumes the entire group; L_unit = mean over members' masked completion losses (P2 OPTION A)
design.mix_P13: L = alpha * L_group + (1-alpha) * L_replay, alpha = 0.58 at unit level; replay rows balanced across protected families (P14); row percentages reported but are NOT the mix
design.output_contract_P15: opaque codes ONLY; no query->entity auxiliary objective
design.split_P0_P1: groups partitioned BEFORE flattening; train_group_ids INTERSECT heldout_group_ids = EMPTY; audit committed to data/grouped_queryswap/split_audit.json with hashes

dev_metrics_at_each_point: QIM-v2 paired parent delta where computed
trajectory_P6.prior_trajectory_status: the tp-grouped-queryswap-001 trajectory (~5..50) was NOT EXECUTED; only ~59 and ~81 were evaluated. Recorded honestly; this run executes the registered grid.

data_mix_replay_P14.symbolic_role: MONITORED only — not a protection gate unless CapabilityContract promotes it

pre_registered_predictions.PR1_dev_lift_delta: On QIM-v2 development: child mean group lift > parent mean group lift by >= +0.4 nats (justified by the observed developmental +0.669 candidate-level effect; not trivially easy)
pre_registered_predictions.PR2_group_level_significance_v3: On FROZEN QIM-v3 replication ONLY, evaluated ONCE on the selected child AFTER freezing: paired child-parent per-group delta sign-flip p < 0.05 over independent groups
pre_registered_predictions.PR3_effect_size_v3: mean child-parent query-lift delta on QIM-v3 >= +0.4 nats
pre_registered_predictions.PR4_rank_movement: child rank-1 fraction > parent rank-1 fraction on QIM-v3 by >= 2/40 candidates (directional behavioral movement beyond chance)
pre_registered_predictions.PR5_greedy_directional: child greedy corresponding-value accuracy > parent greedy accuracy on QIM-v3 (directional, no magnitude required)
pre_registered_predictions.PR6_extraction_floor: context_value_extraction: child fraction >= parent fraction - 0.085 (one item of twelve)
pre_registered_predictions.PR7_protected_retention: every protected family (single_fact, tool_result, copy, protocol_transfer) >= own parent baseline - 0.10

falsification_rules_P23.RESULT_A_NO_REPLICATION: group-level lift delta disappears or PR2 fails badly => original SFT5 signal was NOT established; DO NOT scale this objective
falsification_rules_P23.RESULT_B_LATENT_ONLY: lift replicates (PR2/PR3 pass) but rank/greedy do not move (PR4/PR5 fail) => latent conditional preference formed; behavioral control remains insufficient; next question: what prevents the preference from dominating competing values
falsification_rules_P23.RESULT_C_FULL: lift + rank + greedy improve while retention holds => strongest result; replicate behavior on a fresh frozen suite before any scaling
falsification_rules_P23.RESULT_D_SPECIALIST: conditioning improves but extraction or retention breaks floors => REJECT the child; narrow specialist again

P22_order: load exact accumulation parent; evaluate parent on QIM-v2 AND QIM-v3 baselines
train replication child from parent with trajectory evals
select candidate using DEVELOPMENT metrics only
evaluate selected child EXACTLY ONCE on QIM-v3 with parent pairing
NO retraining because of QIM-v3 results
evaluation_discipline.qim_v3_role_P4: FINAL INDEPENDENT REPLICATION CHECK: never used for selection, never used to modify or retrain the child
